title: Expectation of a constant function
statement: For any real number $c$, the constant Boolean function $f\colon\{0,1\}^n\to\bbr$ with $f(x)=c$ for all $x$ has expectation $\E[f]=c$ under the uniform measure.
hypotheses_covered: constant value c is a real number
replaced: The expectation over the cube of the constant function with value $c$ equals $c$.
